# LLMScore

> LLMScore is an AI search readiness audit tool. Point it at a URL and get a 0–100 score with ranked, actionable fixes across the LLM optimisation layer: llms.txt, llms-full.txt, JSON-LD for AI extraction, AI-crawler robots config, content extractability, sitemap completeness, canonical coverage, OG/Twitter cards and internal linking.

LLMScore is built for B2B SaaS companies, content-heavy sites and marketing teams who depend on search traffic and are watching AI search (Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT search, Perplexity) grow.

## Pages

- [Home](https://llmscore.io/): What LLMScore audits, how it works, and a sample report. Get your AI search readiness score.

## What LLMScore checks

- [What is llms.txt?](https://llmscore.io/checks/llms-txt): What llms.txt is, why it matters for AI search, and how LLMScore validates it.
- [llms-full.txt explained](https://llmscore.io/checks/llms-full-txt): The complete page index for AI crawlers and why coverage beats curation.
- [JSON-LD for AI extraction](https://llmscore.io/checks/json-ld): Will an LLM get a clean answer from your structured data?
- [AI crawler robots config](https://llmscore.io/checks/robots): Are GPTBot, ClaudeBot and PerplexityBot allowed to read your site?
- [Content extractability](https://llmscore.io/checks/extractability): Question-based headings, TL;DR blocks and answer-shaped content that wins citations.
- [Sitemap completeness](https://llmscore.io/checks/sitemap): Can AI crawlers find all your pages? Missing pages and orphans explained.
- [Canonical coverage](https://llmscore.io/checks/canonicals): How duplicate URL variants split your citations, and how to consolidate them.
- [OG / Twitter cards](https://llmscore.io/checks/og-cards): The preview contract AI citation cards are built from.
- [Internal linking](https://llmscore.io/checks/internal-links): Why key pages must be reachable within two clicks, and how to fix orphans.
